commits.summary: Replay pinned public Java callers and compare six merged changes
commits.body:
Add a finite public-API comparison to the example router. Each history gets the same compiled caller in a fresh JVM with a checked JDK, ordered JAR digests and observed class providers. Examples 403–406, 419 and 422 cover Lucene, JTS, RoaringBitmap, DataSketches, both jOOλ modules and both Guava editions.

Eight deployment pairs ran 48 physical trials and reproduced their receipts through the ordinary example command. Both jOOλ variants refuted the wide-bound prediction; Guava supplied the iterator-count difference its upstream tests missed. All six example validations and all 57 repository-selected test suites passed.

commits.summary: Complete the merged Java public API campaign (verification pending)
commits.body:
Add the other fourteen public callers, the campaign audit and the twenty-case report. All 20 merged intent predictions and 20 unchanged controls held. Jackson CSV, Avro, ical4j and both jOOλ modules refuted four challenge predictions. Preserve the original expectations, typed outcomes, runtime digests and overlay boundaries. The H2 and PostgreSQL 16.16 and 18.1 jOOQ histories reproduce both the counting discrepancy and the repair.

All 143 physical observations across 24 deployment pairs were reproduced through the normal example route. All fourteen new example validations and the 56 selected test suites passed. The audit checks 61 original claim rows and the retained Avro receipt confirms four original-method entries. Adding a missing observation, wrong result or reversed source pins to the audit's inputs was checked to fail.
